fields.description: Naming series prefix that auto-generates the unique root-cause analysis number.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: Current stage of the failure investigation, from draft through analysis to closure.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Inspection
Analysis
Root Cause Identified
Corrective Action
Verification
Closed
Cancelled

fields.description: Short standardized code classifying the type of failure for reporting and trend analysis.
fields.label: Failure Code

fields.description: How serious the failure is, driving prioritization and escalation of the corrective work.
fields.label: Severity

fields.description: Marks that the failure poses a safety hazard to people or property and needs urgent attention.
fields.label: Safety Risk

fields.description: The service job during which this failure was discovered or is being investigated.
fields.label: Service Job

fields.description: The specific on-site visit where the failure was observed by the technician.
fields.label: Service Visit

fields.description: The installed unit that experienced the failure being analyzed.
fields.label: Installed Equipment

fields.description: The equipment inspection record that first flagged or documented this failure.
fields.label: Equipment Inspection

fields.description: The observable problem or malfunction as first reported or noticed on the equipment.
fields.label: Symptom

fields.description: The underlying reason determined to have caused the failure after investigation.
fields.label: Root Cause

fields.description: The repair or remedy carried out to fix the failure and its root cause.
fields.label: Corrective Action

fields.description: How the corrective action was confirmed effective, such as a retest or follow-up check.
fields.label: Verification

fields.description: Indicates this failure has occurred before on the same equipment.
fields.label: Repeat Failure

fields.description: Number of prior recorded failures on this equipment, used to detect chronic problems.
fields.label: Previous Failure Count

fields.description: Indicates the case was escalated to a manager or specialist for further handling.
fields.label: Escalated

fields.description: System-suggested priority for the corrective work based on severity and repeat history.
fields.label: Priority Suggestion

fields.description: Date and time the failure analysis was completed and closed.
fields.label: Closed On

fields.description: Reference to the original document this amended analysis was created from.
fields.label: Amended From
